summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing the delivery of its new wind installation vessel, Wind Ace, on schedule and within budget. This is an operational update, not a special situation. The vessel will deploy on ScottishPower Renewables' East Anglia TWO offshore wind farm. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is involved. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. The registrant is the issuer of the vessel, but the event does not meet the criteria for a special-situation classification.
